title: Review of c09's active-gel regulator-window negative: replicates on fresh seed 4 (ks 0.05, rho 1.5, kb 0.05: comets with long tails swim up to 23.5 BL, 2 persistent splits vs 92 merges; ks 0.03, rho 2, kb 0.1: no bodies)
summary: Ran two points of the scan on seed 4, T=300: the comets world with WORLD_P ks=0.05, rho=1.5, kb=0.05, and the finding's world_ks0.03_r2_kb0.1.py. First point: after a labyrinth at t~13-25, ~15-36 comets with regulator tails swim (71 long-lived tracks >= 1 BL, max 23.5 BL); labkit counts 52 splits but only 2 persistent (generation 2) against 92 merges, and in the sheet I see collisions and nucleations, not clean comet fissions. Second point: no component ever forms (0 bodies). Both match the finding's table for seeds 0 and 1.

observations.D: summary.txt: ks 0.05/rho 1.5/kb 0.05 seed 4: 2 persistent splits, 92 merges, max 23.5 BL; ks 0.03/rho 2/kb 0.1 seed 4: 0 bodies

seeds_run.result: low supply, strong regulator: nothing forms

controls_run.D: two scan points on the same seed

verdicts.limitation: Two of the 28 scan points, one fresh seed. The negative covers this regulator family and range only.
